citation.authors: Lakdim L, Naitlhou A, Carroll R

cited_by.title: Lupus: symptoms, risk and getting diagnosed early

record.population: 61 people with lupus at one internal medicine department in Casablanca, Morocco, 2017 to 2022
record.finding: 90.2% were women, mean age at diagnosis 40.3 years. Fatigue (82.0%), joint pain (70.5%) and malar rash (59.0%) were most common; anaemia affected 47.5% and renal involvement 16.4%. The authors note restricted access to advanced targeted treatments.
record.note: North African single centre; descriptive, no comparison group.
